A seat is one hull on the vessel register, holding its own MMSI. The applicant files the hull number, a berth on the island quay and the transponder serial. A coast station logs each position, and the pass near zenith catches a deck that switched its unit off. An MMSI already seated is cut, as is a second seat at one berth within the hour.

Fifty clones need fifty hulls: 18,000 dollars used, 600 licence, 900 transponder, 240 a month berth, near 1.1 million before a wake forms. The channel runs jade over the reef, and a copy leaves the same wash; only the log says which deck was there.
